measurement_definitions: Strict per-L-frame precision/recall: aligned repaired sample differs from corrupted input by >1e-4; known injected sample mask is ground truth. Interpolated clean neighbors count against strict precision. +/-16-frame guards exclude expected repair footprint from collateral L damage. R is uncorrupted and linked, with collateral RMS reported. Clean references are retained unchanged; no quiet-slot selection or parameter tuning.
limits: Two half-second recorded excerpts and one synthetic percussion signal, at 48 kHz; conditional numerical benchmark, not a population-scale music or release-corpus replacement. Controls fixed a priori: sensitivity 2 and 10; all random/periodic, one/two/three-band modes, width zero, default pair linking. Conservative sensitivity 10 clean peak <=0.05; isolated synthetic one-frame click error <=0.25 derived from bounded HF/LF components. Crackle and dense clusters are reported without claiming universal removal.

crackle.amplitude: 0.04 for even seed; -0.08 for odd seed
